'''Otis Young''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[RamapoCon III Open]] on 9 June 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|10 panic WYS]], according to Mike Gemme's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2450">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-13-ramapo-uncensored-easy-sloppy-twad2450/ ramapo-uncensored-easy-sloppy-twa], DeckTech (michael "Deck" Gemme, 13 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-13-ramapo-uncensored-easy-sloppy-twad2450/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
